name: Phaedimus
bio: Phaedimus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to c. 300 BC. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of Meleager's Wreath, the Garland compiled about 100 BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the first volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Books I–VI) (Book VI: 271).

poems.title: Book VI, 271
poems.author: Phaedimus
poems.text: Artemis, the son of Cichesias dedicated the shoes to thee, and Themistodice the simple folds of her ‘gown, because that coming in gentle guise without thy bow thou didst hold thy two hands over her in her labour. But Artemis, vouchsafe to see this baby boy of Leon’s grow great and strong.
